SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 132
Central P. B. Station
Date March 25th 1929.

Subject (in full) Ex-Nanking War Prisoners.

Made by P. C. S. Maklaevsky Forwarded by W. Givens A. C. Pol

Sir,
With reference to the attached translation from the
"Shanghai Zarya" of March 15, 1929 re the departure of ex-
Nanking war prisoners, inquiries show that of the 65 men who
arrived here from Nanking in January and February 1929, 17
left Shanghai for Harbin on February 23, 1929 but on arrival
in Dairen, 8 of them joined the newly formed Chinese Army
of Marshal Chang Jung Chang and the remainder proceeded to
their destination in Harbin. On March 14, 1929 another party
of 7 men left Shanghai for Harbin and Hailar on Chinese Eastern
Railway, where they have relatives among the former Trans-
Baikal Cossacks, who are now engaged in farm work there.
Of the remainder 10 joined the Russian Unit, S.V.C., 23 men
obtained employment locally and the remainder still reside
in the premises attached to the Russian Church off North
Szechuen Road, Chapei. It is expected that employment will
be found for them in due course.

B. Maklaevsky
P. C. S.

HR.
25/3.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. D. 132
中央捕房
日期：1929年3月25日。

事由（全称）：前南京战俘。

呈报人：警佐马卡耶夫斯基（P. C. S. Maklaevsky） 转呈人：W. Givens，助理警务处长

先生：

关于随附的1929年3月15日《上海霞报》（Shanghai Zarya）有关前南京战俘离沪情况的译文，经查询得知，在1929年1月和2月间从南京抵达此地的65人中，有17人于1929年2月23日离开上海前往哈尔滨，但在抵达大连后，其中8人加入了张作霖元帅新组建的中国军队，其余人员则继续前往目的地哈尔滨。1929年3月14日，另一批7人离开上海，经中东铁路前往哈尔滨和海拉尔，他们在那里有亲属，这些亲属是前外贝加尔哥萨克人，目前在那里从事农耕工作。其余人员中，有10人加入了俄国分队（S.V.C.），23人在本地找到了工作，剩下的人仍居住在闸北北四川路旁俄国教堂附属的房屋内。预计他们将在适当时候找到工作。

B. 马卡耶夫斯基
警佐

HR.
3月25日。
呈助理警务处长

Further departure of ex Banking prisoners.

Seven more men of the ex Banking prisoners are
leaving Shanghai to-day for the Chinese Eastern Railway
zone. They have been provided with tickets by the
Fraternax Fraternity. There are only eleven men remaining
men in charge of the Fraternity in the Siberian provinces.

Gen. Horvath thanked by the Grand Dutchess
Anastasia Nikolaevna.

Gen. Horvath received a letter of thanks from the
Grand Dutchess Anastasia Nikolaevna, wife of the deceased
Grand Duke Mikhail Nikolaevich, addressed to all Russians
in the Far East, in reply to sympathies expressed to her
wherein she also hopes that Russia will soon be free
through the united efforts of all Russian people.

（左侧手写批注：Sufficiency / J.P.）

前银行囚犯进一步离境。

另有七名前银行囚犯今日离开上海，前往中东铁路区。他们的车票由“Fraternax”兄弟会（Fraternax Fraternity）提供。在西伯利亚各省，由该兄弟会负责照管的男子仅余十一人。

霍瓦特将军获安娜斯塔西娅·尼古拉耶芙娜女大公致谢。

霍瓦特将军收到安娜斯塔西娅·尼古拉耶芙娜女大公的感谢信。安娜斯塔西娅系已故米哈伊尔·尼古拉耶维奇大公之妻。该信致远东全体俄国人，以回复向她表达的慰问之情；她在信中还希望，通过全体俄国人民的共同努力，俄国不久将获得自由。

（左侧手写批注：充足 / J.P.）
